zh: 我已经做完今天的工作，可以早点回家。
old_en: I've finished today's work, so I can go home early.
new_en: I've finished today's work, so I can go home early.

zh: 这周我已经加了三天班，特别累。
old_en: This week, I've been working overtime for three days, feeling really tired.
new_en: This week, I've worked overtime for three days and feel really tired.

zh: 快递到现在还没收到，我有点着急。
old_en: I've been waiting for the delivery for five days and I'm getting anxious.
new_en: The delivery still hasn't arrived, and I'm getting anxious.

zh: 我在这座城市已经住了五年。
old_en: I have lived in this city for five years.
new_en: I've lived in this city for five years.

zh: 我在这座城市住了五年，认识了不少朋友。
old_en: I've lived in this city for five years and met many friends.
new_en: I've lived in this city for five years and made many friends.

zh: 我去过海边三次，每次都很开心。
old_en: I've been to the seaside three times, and each visit was delightful.
new_en: I've been to the seaside three times, and each time was great.

zh: 海边我去过三次，最喜欢秋天去。
old_en: I've been to the beach three times, and I like autumn the most.
new_en: I've been to the beach three times, and I like going there in autumn the most.

zh: 这家店我还没吃过，听说味道不错。
old_en: I've never tried this restaurant, but it seems to have great food.
new_en: I haven't tried this place yet, but I've heard the food is really good.

zh: 我还没吃过这家店，今天想试试。
old_en: I've never tried this restaurant, but I want to give it a shot today.
new_en: I haven't eaten at this restaurant before, but I want to try it today.

zh: 今天的工作我已经做完了，现在有空。
old_en: I've finished today's work, so I'm free now.
new_en: I've finished today's work, so I'm free now.

zh: 我从来没学过游泳，有点怕水。
old_en: I've never learned to swim, so I'm a bit afraid of water.
new_en: I've never learned to swim, so I'm a bit scared of water.

zh: 她从来没学过游泳，却敢下海。
old_en: She has never learned to swim, yet she dares to go into the sea.
new_en: She has never learned to swim, yet she dares to go into the sea.

zh: 我刚刚收到你的邮件，正在看。
old_en: I have just read your email, checking it now.
new_en: I just got your email and am reading it now.

zh: 刚刚收到你的邮件，我马上回复你。
old_en: I have just received your email and will reply to you right away.
new_en: I have just received your email and will reply right away.

zh: 这周我已经加了三天班，周末想好好休息。
old_en: This week, I've already worked overtime for three days, so I plan to relax at the weekend.
new_en: This week, I've already worked extra days and want to rest over the weekend.

zh: 我认识他已经十年了，他是个可靠的人。
old_en: I've known him for ten years, and he's a reliable person.
new_en: I've known him for ten years, and he's reliable.

zh: 我们认识十年了，一直是很好的朋友。
old_en: We've been friends for ten years.
new_en: We've been friends for ten years and are always good friends.

zh: 我最近一直睡不好，白天没精神。
old_en: I've been feeling really tired during the day lately.
new_en: I've been having trouble sleeping lately and feel tired during the day.

zh: 最近我一直睡不好，想去看医生。
old_en: I've been having trouble sleeping lately, so I want to see a doctor.
new_en: I've been having trouble sleeping lately, so I want to see a doctor.

zh: 我到现在还没收到快递，已经等了五天。
old_en: I've been waiting for the delivery for five days and still haven't received it.
new_en: I still haven't received the package after waiting for five days.
